asked: # Fix a failing AXF Dev Console systems check: Console public URL is set The console's systems check reported this, and its automatic fix failed. Fix the cause, then re-check. - Check id: `routine:env-axf-public-url` (service console, status warn) - What it says: AXF_PUBLIC_URL isn't set - How the fix failed: To stop it coming back after a reinstall, `deploy/install-console.sh` should pass the variable on the Coolify run. That's the fix I proposed earlier, and it's still waiting on your go. Details: - Alerts and push notifications build their links from AXF_PUBLIC_URL, so links are empty when it isn't set. - env {"name": "AXF_PUBLIC_URL"} How it's fixed by hand: - In Coolify, open the console app → Environment variables. - Add AXF_PUBLIC_URL=https://console.amberxai.com and redeploy. Rules: - Fix only this check. Change nothing unrelated; never delete data, volumes, containers or other people's files. - Never print, copy or commit secrets (tokens, keys, .env files, .axf-console/). - Code changes go on this worktree's branch only: commit and push the branch, never main, never merge. - When done, refresh the host report: `bash /opt/axf/deploy/console-doctor.sh --report`. - Record steps and the result on your change-log entry (the hooks do most of it; `changes.mjs step|result last …`). - You may run shell commands on the VPS (you run as root): prefer the smallest, reversible change.

steps.text: install-console.sh passes AXF_PUBLIC_URL to the console container

result.summary: install-console.sh now passes AXF_PUBLIC_URL (default https://$DOMAIN); committed 48626517 on fix/syscheck-routine-env-axf-public-url, push failed: no GitHub credentials on the VPS. Live check stays warn until merged and the 5-min update recreates the container.
